title: EAC module delivery in 2021: encrypted transport, manual map and trust boundary
summary: Aftermath Labs reports distinct steps from x86 launcher through encrypted image delivery and kernel mapping into a game; the demonstrated image-validation concern is scoped to those source-described components and not a current bypass assertion.
author: Observatory editorial
takeaways: Distinguish encrypted transport, image encoding and mapping: they defend different boundaries.
A manually mapped DLL can be treated as trusted by address even when the image content has not been authenticated in the studied path.
The author expressly says some memory checks are inlined and the complete product was not reversed; universal evasion is not proven.
